headline: SpaceX reports revenue surge and $4.4 billion profit driven by AI expansion
summary: SpaceX posted a profit of $4.4 billion, reversing previous losses, as revenue surged on the back of artificial intelligence expansion.
why: Large private or newly prominent commercial space and infrastructure companies can significantly impact market sentiment when they report large profitability milestones.

impacts.name: Technology and Aerospace
impacts.why: Strong profit performance tied to artificial intelligence demand boosted investor confidence in related technology sectors.

why_moved: A sharp turnaround to substantial profitability driven by AI infrastructure demand surprised markets and boosted tech sector momentum.
